description: APPROVAL CARD ONLY — NEVER auto-executed: propose one atomic bracket (entry + protective stop + 1–3 OCO take-profits) for in-app approval. Recorded as a proposed setup row (Diary → setups → Send to ticket). Never executes, never moves funds. Needs the trade:propose scope (PAT).

entry_type.description: market = fill now; limit = resting entry at entry_price

fee_usd.description: All-in fee in USD. Omit or null if unknown — never 0-substituted.

stop_price.description: Protective stop. Long: below entry; short: above. Must be > 0.

take_profits.description: 1–3 take-profit legs {price > 0, weight (or fraction) 0..1 of position}. Weights should sum to ~1.

name: propose_bracket
title: Propose bracket order
